title: Sordland/Turn03/Dictator Post Discussion
description: Discussion after dictator draft has been selected.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After looking into the changes the..."
entries.dialogueText: After looking into the changes the team began discussing it amongst themselves. Lucian spoke afterwards.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the final changes to the prop..."
entries.dialogueText: After the final changes to the proposal were made, I showed it to the team.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Looks like the amendments are read..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looks like the amendments are ready to be proposed."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. Clavin will be tougher to brea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Clavin will be tougher to break. The problem is that he can also influence the moderates against this."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I think we can end the meeting her..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we can end the meeting here."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But sir, I understand that you're..."
entries.dialogueText: "But sir, I understand that you're trying to get rid of the impeachment, however I have to say that it may create problems within the party."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We have to make sure they get behi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have to make sure they get behind that part. We do not want to lose the support of USP."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll figure it out.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll figure it out."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will make sure they get behind.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will make sure they get behind."
entries.menuText: "I will make sure they get behind."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I appreciate your comments but the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your comments but the decision is made."
entries.menuText: "I appreciate your comments but the decision is made."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Wish you good luck with the party,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wish you good luck with the party, sir."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will handle the party.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will handle the party."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We all shook hands and they left th..."
entries.dialogueText: We all shook hands and they left the room.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We will all be doing our part, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will all be doing our part, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We will all do our best to make it..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will all do our best to make it work, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I have to say...""
entries.dialogueText: "I have to say..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Understood.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The new lower electoral threshold..."
entries.dialogueText: "The new lower electoral threshold will be really difficult for the party to accept. Our guys are not fond of that idea."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will not give in.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will not give in."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But I have to say this too...""
entries.dialogueText: "But I have to say this too..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Not reforming the minister laws wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not reforming the minister laws will be frowned upon by the party. The Assembly members have insisted on getting involved in the process."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That's true. It will be tough to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's true. It will be tough to get all of their support. Some of our members may try to openly fight against this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for the advice.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for the advice."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Not reforming the minister laws wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not reforming the minister laws will also be frowned upon by the party. The Assembly members have insisted on getting involved in the process."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And be prepared to reconsider the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And be prepared to reconsider the proposal if it comes to that, sir."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm prepared to reconsider if it c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm prepared to reconsider if it comes to that."
entries.menuText: "I'm prepared to reconsider if it comes to that."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In the meantime, you must introduc..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, you must introduce this proposal to our party, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You must also be prepared to recon..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must also be prepared to reconsider the proposal if it comes to that."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Any other comments before we proce..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any other comments before we proceed?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We will be working on the wording..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will be working on the wording of the proposal with our legal experts before we propose it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You'll need to a strong speech to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll need to a strong speech to get them behind you. But I advise you to first talk to the leaders of the both conservative and reformist wings of the party."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Sir, you are pretty well-versed in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, you are pretty well-versed in speeches. You know the party. Just make sure you get them hyped up about the reforms."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As much as I don't want to say thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As much as I don't want to say this, if they make any demands to change the proposal, you may need to give in."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Any other comments before we proce..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any other comments before we proceed?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As Mr. Vectern said, Mrs. Tory wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "As Mr. Vectern said, Mrs. Tory will probably be easier to persuade. We need to unite the party under these changes, so her support is vital."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""As far as I'm aware, Mr. Clavin wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As far as I'm aware, Mr. Clavin will be our biggest problem, he may try to paint you as a dictator. Mrs. Tory will also be tough but we'll need to get her first."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Any advice in regards to dealing w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any advice in regards to dealing with them?"
entries.menuText: "Any advice in regards to dealing with them?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Any advice for the speech?""
entries.dialogueText: "Any advice for the speech?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will handle them.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will handle them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Then we will fight back.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then we will fight back."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm good.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm good."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Let's proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's proceed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked at me."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked at me.
